title: [Bug-Report|缺陷反馈]: qbmmia当输入的groupSize为0时，inputSizeK推导不正确
body:
Thanks for sending an issue! Please fill in the following template to help quickly solve your problem.

### Describe the current behavior / 问题描述 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
修改groupSize推导逻辑，当输入的groupSize为0时，会自动进行推导，当量化类型是e8m0时，x1 Scale的shape应该为[m, k/2, 2] 或者[k/2, m, 2]，inputSizeK的值应该再乘以2，否则会推导错误
### Environment / 环境信息 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
Ascend950
cann9.0.0
### Steps to reproduce the issue / 重现步骤 (Mandatory / 必填)

 当输入的groupSize为0时，进行自动推导时，推导结果为[1,1,64]
### Describe the expected behavior / 预期结果 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
groupSize能够正确推导为[1,1,32]
### Related log / screenshot / 日志 / 截图 (Mandatory / 必填)

![image.png](https://raw.gitcode.com/user-images/assets/7665709/9e6f8e09-3274-49a1-98c2-741f07def4bc/image.png 'image.png')
### Special notes for this issue/备注 (Optional / 选填)
